name: Palau
description: Palau from its first islanders to Spanish, German, Japanese and American rule, the battle of Peleliu and independence in 1994.

checkpoints.name: Islanders and colonists
checkpoints.note: Palauans lived on the islands for some 3,000 years. Spain, Germany, Japan and the United States ruled, and Peleliu was a terrible battlefield in 1944.

checkpoints.name: Independent Palau
checkpoints.note: Palau became independent in free association with the United States in 1994.
